name: Leg Press
common_faults: feet too low causing excessive knee shear
lifting glutes off seat at depth

substitutions.note: adds axial load and full-body stability demand

contraindications: acute knee injury during loaded knee flexion
resistance_profile: hardest at the bottom; leverage improves toward lockout

provenance.notes: Removes axial/spinal load; useful for quad volume with back issues. Foot placement significantly alters muscle emphasis.
